name: Polycab India

snapshot.about: Polycab India Limited manufactures wires, cables, fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG), and executes EPC projects.

narrative: Management promised long-term EBITDA margins of 11% to 13%, which aligns with FY26 EBITDA margin of 13.9% and Q2 FY27 margin of 14.4%. However, FMEG Q4 FY26 EBIT margin of 4.1% diverged from the 8% to 10% target before recovering.

promises.statement: Working capital cycle is expected to normalize to a long-term range of 50 to 55 days.

said.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters

actual_source.quote: our working capital cycle has improved to 25 days in Quarter 4

promises.note: Working capital cycle improved to 11 days in Q2 FY27, below the long-term target range.

promises.statement: EPC annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in high single digits over mid-to-long term.

said.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid￾to long term

actual_source.quote: Despite the lower revenue base, profitability remained healthy at INR 338 million, translating into a margin of 11%

promises.note: EPC EBIT margins stood at 11% in Q1 FY27 and 7.2% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Polycab has a long-term Project Spring margin guidance of 11% to 13%.

said.quote: to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%

actual_source.quote: EBITDA grew faster than revenue, increasing by 35% year-on-year with margins expanding to 13.9%

promises.note: EBITDA margins reached 13.9% in FY26 and expanded to 14.4% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: On a normalized basis, working capital cycle is expected to revert to 45 to 50 days.

said.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the working capital cycle to revert to our steady-state range of 45 to 50 days

actual_source.quote: We also witnessed further improvement in our working capital efficiency, with the average working capital cycle reducing to approximately 11 days in second quarter fiscal '27

promises.note: Working capital cycle reduced to 11 days in Q2 FY27 while long-term targets remain unchanged.

promises.statement: Management remains on track to execute planned capex of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over next 5 years.

said.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years

actual_source.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter amounted to INR 3.2 billion, reflecting our continued commitment to building capacity and strengthening future growth drivers

promises.note: Long-term capex plan progresses with 6.1 billion rupees spent in H1 FY27.

promises.metric: Near to mid term EBITDA margin
promises.statement: In the near to mid term, Polycab expects 12% to 14% EBITDA margins.

said.quote: and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA

actual_source.quote: EBITDA increased by 32% year￾on-year and the margins stood at 13.8%, reflecting an improvement of approximately 70 basis points sequentially over the previous quarter

promises.note: EBITDA margins were 13.8% in Q1 FY27 and 14.4% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Company continues to pump INR 1,200 crores to INR 1,600 crores capex every year.

said.quote: And we are continuing to pump INR 1,200 crores to INR 1,600 crores every year, adding capacity

actual_source.quote: During the first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion, reflecting our ongoing investments in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities and future growth platforms

promises.note: Incurred 6.1 billion rupees capex in H1 FY27 towards annual capacity expansion.

promises.statement: Management guides for a medium to long-term EBIT margin of 11% to 13% for Wires & Cables.

said.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business

actual_source.quote: EBIT margins for the Wires & Cables business stood at 13.3%

promises.note: Wires and Cables EBIT margin reached 13.3% in Q1 FY27 and 14.2% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Company aims to grow FMEG segment at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth.

said.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability

actual_source.quote: The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth with strong performance across all major product categories

promises.note: FMEG segment registered 124% YoY growth in Q2 FY27, delivering strong market outperformance.

promises.statement: Management targets company growth at 1.5x of market growth.

said.quote: So as long as there is growth in the volumes or growth in the market, we definitely do better than the industry growth rate. That is the only guidance we can give

actual_source.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum

promises.note: Consolidated revenue grew 53% YoY in Q2 FY27 and 46% YoY in H1 FY27.

promises.metric: Wires and Cables EBITDA margin guidance
promises.statement: Polycab expects to sustain medium to long-term Wires and Cables EBITDA margin in the 11% to 13% range.

said.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%

actual_source.quote: EBIT margins in the Wires and Cables segment stood at 14.2%

promises.note: Segment EBIT margin achieved 14.2% in Q2 FY27, exceeding medium-term guidance range.

promises.statement: Target for FMEG business is to grow at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth rate.

said.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability

actual_source.quote: The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth with strong performance across all major product categories

promises.note: FMEG segment revenue surged 124% YoY in Q2 FY27 showing strong operational momentum.

promises.metric: Wires and Cables relative volume growth target
promises.statement: Polycab aims to grow Wires and Cables volumes at 1.5x of market growth rate long term.

said.quote: What we have called out already, as an anchor to look into the volume growth, is that whatever the market grows, we will do 1.5x of that in cable and wires

actual_source.quote: The Wires and Cables segment delivered a strong quarter, recording 47% year-on-year revenue growth

promises.note: Segment revenue surged 47% YoY with domestic business growing 50% YoY in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Project Spring targets investing INR 12 billion to 16 billion annually through FY30.

said.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30

actual_source.quote: taking the total capex for full financial year to approximately INR14.8 billion

promises.note: Annual capex reached 14.8 billion rupees in FY26 and H1 FY27 capex reached 6.1 billion rupees.

promises.statement: FMEG EBITDA margins targeted in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30.

said.quote: achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30

actual_source.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030

promises.note: FMEG segment EBIT margins expanded to 8% in Q1 FY27 and 10.1% in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Company targets greater than 10% contribution from exports by FY30.

said.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030

actual_source.quote: Our international business delivered robust performance, growing 18% year-on-year and contributing 4.4% of consolidated revenue

promises.note: International sales contributed 4.4% in Q4 FY26 and export sales grew 17% YoY in Q2 FY27.

promises.metric: Bharat Net execution revenue in FY27
promises.statement: Management expects INR 800 crore to INR 1,000 crore revenue from Bharat Net in FY27.

said.quote: So we can safely say maybe 1/3rd of that should translate into revenue, maybe INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores may come from Bharat Net alone

actual_source.quote: The EPC segment reported revenues of INR 6,171 million in Q2 FY27, representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%

promises.statement: Management expects around INR 800 crore revenue translation from RDSS in FY27.

said.quote: And again, in case of RDSS, since the execution piece is around 3 years, we should expect about INR 800-odd crores translating this year

actual_source.quote: The EPC segment reported revenues of INR 6,171 million in Q2 FY27, representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%

promises.statement: Management expects EHV plant commissioning in FY28.

said.quote: So I would like to take this opportunity to sort of also let the investor community know that in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹8,856 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹8,756 crore.
signals.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

cash.read: Profits reliably convert into cash. Over FY22 to FY26, cumulative operating cash flow of ₹8,856 crore fully covered total reported profit of ₹8,756 crore.

bull.point: Polycab achieved rapid top-line growth, with consolidated revenue expanding 53% year-on-year to ₹9,899 crore in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum

bull.point: FMEG profitability improved sharply, with segment EBIT margin crossing 10.1% in Q2 FY27 alongside 124% YoY revenue growth.

evidence.quote: The FMEG segment delivered a breakthrough quarter, registering a remarkable 124% year-on-year growth with strong performance across all major product categories
The segment also achieved a major profitability milestone, with EBIT margins crossing the double-digit mark for the first time and recording a 10.1% margin during the quarter

bull.point: Cash conversion is exceptionally strong, with cumulative operating cash flows fully covering reported net profits over FY22 to FY26.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹8,856 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹8,756 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Auditors highlighted revenue recognition as a key audit matter due to the risk of overstatement before control is transferred to customers.

evidence.quote: Revenue is a key performance indicator for the Group considered by all stakeholders including management to evaluate performance of the Group resulting in the risk of revenue being overstated

bear.point: Auditors noted EPC revenue measurement involves significant complexity and management judgement in estimating total contract costs.

evidence.quote: Considering the complexity of the estimate involved in measurement of total contract costs, extent of management judgement and the significance of these amounts, we have considered measurement of revenue

bear.point: Inventory valuation was designated a key audit matter due to its size and price volatility risks in copper and aluminum raw materials.

evidence.quote: We have considered Inventory Valuation as a key audit matter because of its size, the assumptions used in the valuation and the complexity, which are relevant when determining the amounts
